description: Keeps the touchmark image in .gitlab-ci.yml and .gitea/workflows, and the actions in .github and .gitea workflows, pinned by digest and current.
Every update is a merge request that a person reviews and merges: its plan job runs the new touchmark against the targets, with the read token.

GHCR returns no release dates, so minimumReleaseAge cannot age the touchmark image (docs.renovatebot.com/key-concepts/minimum-release-age): a new release would reach the read token at once. Renovate therefore waits for your approval on its Dependency Dashboard before it opens a touchmark merge request: approve it once you have read the release notes and checked the signature, ideally after the week the other updates wait.

packageRules.description: One merge request per touchmark release, for the image and the action together, never merged automatically, and opened only once you approve it on the Dependency Dashboard.
